flowchart RL
    cart[Cart] --> address[Address]
    address --> shipping{Shipping method}
    shipping -->|standard| pay[Payment]
    shipping -->|express| surcharge[Add surcharge]
    surcharge --> pay
    pay --> card{Card OK?}
    card -->|no| pay
    card -->|yes| confirm[Confirmation]
    confirm --> email[Send email]
    confirm --> invoice[Create invoice]
